subject: Implementation handoff — App SDK migration path & smoke test checklist
messages:
From: Alex Moore <alex@quickledger.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation handoff — App SDK migration path & smoke test checklist

Hi Vivek / Monica,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're lining up the internal engineering sprint to migrate our payment-app to Redwood's new SDK-based endpoints. Before we lock dates, we need a concise migration path and a smoke-test checklist that our infra team can run during the canary window.

Specifically we'd like:
- a minimal SDK init snippet (node/python) showing auth and preferred retry/timeouts settings;
- recommended endpoint migration steps (old REST -> new SDK streams) and a safe canary cutover plan;
- guidance on rate-limit bump/fallback behavior and token rotation during rollout;
- a short smoke-test checklist we can hand to our SREs so they can validate production readiness.

Our target cutover week is 2027-06-21; would appreciate any pre-flight checks we can run this week.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moore
Lead Platform Engineer | QuickLedger
alex@quickledger.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex@quickledger.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation handoff — App SDK migration path & smoke test checklist

Alex — adding a short mutual action plan and staffing notes so we have clarity on owners and timing.

Mutual action plan (timeline targets):
- 2027-06-08: QuickLedger runs sandbox SDK tests + shares failing cases (owner: QuickLedger eng).
- 2027-06-10: Redwood and QuickLedger sync (30m) to review sandbox results and finalize canary window (owner: Vivek).
- 2027-06-14: Pre-canary readiness checklist completed; smoke-test checklist signoff (owner: QuickLedger SRE).
- 2027-06-21: Canary start (2–3 day window) with live monitoring and daily readout (owner: QuickLedger/Redwood operations).

CSM & ops responsibilities:
- Redwood (Monica): coordinate scheduled alerting hooks, pre-create rollback playbook, and monitor model_version discrepancies.
- Redwood (Vivek): be on-call for first 48h of canary; assist with throttling tuning.
- QuickLedger (Alex): run smoke tests, validate auth rotation, and confirm traffic-splitting config.

Technical clarifications:
- Token rotation: we recommend rotating a secondary token 24 hours prior to cutover and testing its acceptance in sandbox.
- Quota bumps: if you expect >2x baseline traffic during ramp, request a temporary quota increase via your portal ticket at least 72 hours before the canary.

Please confirm owners and whether a midnight (PST) or midday canary window works better for your team.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Implementation | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Implementation handoff — App SDK migration path & smoke test checklist

Thanks — plan looks good. A few quick notes from the SRE side before we lock the 2027-06-21 canary:

1) Traffic shaping: we'll do a weighted LB rule (1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) over 72 hours. We want an automated rollback if error-rate > 1.5% for 5m. Can Redwood provide a webhook or a simple health endpoint we can query to validate model readiness?

2) Token rotation: we'll rotate tokens during the 10% stage to verify no auth blips; good to hear about the secondary token approach.

3) Quota bump: request submitted (ticket #QL-2027-89) for a temporary burst to match our expected peak during ramp.

4) Last mile: could someone from Redwood ops drop into a 30-minute call at the 10% ramp milestone to review metrics? Prefer 2027-06-22 14:00 PST if possible.

I'll confirm schedule once we run sandbox tests later today.

Best,
Alex
Lead Platform Engineer | QuickLedger
